tools.name: lawcus_get_me
tools.description: Lawcus: the user the API token belongs to (id, uuid, name, timezone, role such as OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER).

tools.name: lawcus_get_firm
tools.description: Lawcus: the firm (team) details: name, address, currency, locale and phone numbers.

tools.name: lawcus_list_team_members
tools.description: Lawcus: the people on the firm's team with id, uuid, name, role and hourly rate. Ids are used in matter, task and report filters.

tools.name: lawcus_search
tools.description: Lawcus: global search across contacts, matters and leads for a keyword.

tools.name: lawcus_list_contacts
tools.description: Lawcus: list contacts (people and companies; clients are contacts), filterable by name, email, type or update date. Paged with skip/take.

tools.name: lawcus_get_contact
tools.description: Lawcus: one contact by UUID, with addresses, phones, emails and custom fields.

tools.name: lawcus_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact in Lawcus (a person or a company). It does not send anything to the contact. Person needs first_name and last_name; Company needs name. Check lawcus_list_contacts first to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: lawcus_list_matters
tools.description: Lawcus: list matters (cases) with status, client, billing type, trust and retainer balances. Filter by status, name, number, client or dates. Paged with skip/take; the reply also carries opened/closed counts.

tools.name: lawcus_get_matter
tools.description: Lawcus: one matter by UUID with its client, workflow stage, billing settings, balances and custom fields.

tools.name: lawcus_list_leads
tools.description: Lawcus: list leads (prospective matters) with client contact details and pipeline stage. Paged with skip/take.

tools.name: lawcus_get_lead
tools.description: Lawcus: one lead by UUID.

tools.name: lawcus_list_lead_sources
tools.description: Lawcus: the firm's lead sources (Website, Referral, Google, ...). Ids go into lead and contact filters.

tools.name: lawcus_list_workflows
tools.description: Lawcus: the workflows (matter and lead pipelines) with their ids.

tools.name: lawcus_list_workflow_stages
tools.description: Lawcus: the stages of one workflow (pipeline).

tools.name: lawcus_list_tasks
tools.description: Lawcus: list tasks, optionally by completion, assignee, matter or tag. The API returns the whole list; the reply is cut to `limit`.

tools.name: lawcus_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task in Lawcus, optionally on a matter and assigned to team members. Lawcus may email or SMS the assignees if reminders are set; no reminders are set by this tool.

tools.name: lawcus_list_time_entries
tools.description: Lawcus: time entries (hours worked, rate, total, matter, invoiced or not). The API returns all entries; filter here by matter and date range, reply cut to `limit`.

tools.name: lawcus_list_expenses
tools.description: Lawcus: expenses logged against matters. The API returns all expenses; filter here by matter and date range, reply cut to `limit`.

tools.name: lawcus_list_billing_items
tools.description: Lawcus: billable activity (time entries, expenses and flat fees) with payment details, filterable by date range, user, practice area, matter, client and invoiced state. Also returns time totals for today/week/month/year.

tools.name: lawcus_list_interactions
tools.description: Lawcus: logged client interactions (emails, calls, secure messages) with subject, matter and contact. Paged with skip/paginate.

tools.name: lawcus_report_accounts_receivable
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): unpaid invoices by age (who owes the firm what).

tools.name: lawcus_report_matter_balance
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): balance summary of all matters, optionally trust balances only.

tools.name: lawcus_report_revenue
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): revenue by attorney for a period.

tools.name: lawcus_report_time_entries
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): time entries summarized per user for a period.

tools.name: lawcus_report_payments_collected
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): payments the firm collected in a period.

tools.name: lawcus_report_invoice_history
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): summary of issued invoices for a period.

tools.name: lawcus_report_client_trust
tools.description: Lawcus report (needs the Admin role): client trust (IOLTA) balances; zero balances hidden unless display_zero is true.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lawcus_list_contacts, lawcus_get_contact, lawcus_list_interactions · Private data: lawcus_get_me, lawcus_search, lawcus_list_contacts, lawcus_get_contact, lawcus_create_contact, lawcus_list_leads, lawcus_list_lead_sources, lawcus_list_interactions · Public sink: lawcus_list_contacts, lawcus_create_contact, lawcus_create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lawcus_list_contacts, lawcus_get_contact, lawcus_list_interactions · Private data: lawcus_get_me, lawcus_search, lawcus_list_contacts, lawcus_get_contact, lawcus_create_contact, lawcus_list_leads, lawcus_list_lead_sources, lawcus_list_interactions · Public sink: lawcus_list_contacts, lawcus_create_contact, lawcus_create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
